name: Bracken Ford
description: A small riverside town where the old road fords the Brenn, with a market, an inn and no great opinion of itself.

gate.name: The Ford Gate
gate.description: A low timber gate in a palisade, standing open. The road you came by runs west along the river toward Telgard, and the town lies ahead.

square.name: The Market Square
square.description: A small square of beaten earth round a well. Doors open off it on every side, and the river sounds just behind the houses.

armoury.name: The Armoury
armoury.description: A cramped shop whose walls are hung with blades and cudgels, and whose floor is hidden under shields.

provisions.name: The Provisions Store
provisions.description: A dim store of sacks and jars and bundles of moss, smelling pleasantly of rope and herbs.

inn.name: The Sign of the Ford
inn.description: A clean, low-beamed inn with a hearth and a smell of bread. The innkeeper keeps a ledger of the beds on a slate.

north.failure_message: A narrow door at the back of the inn is locked. A brass key would answer it.

dew_shop.name: The Dew Seller's
dew_shop.description: A small, cold room behind a locked door, where a woman sells vials of glimmering water from a shelf cut into the wall.
